objects.represents: A container holding a small number of tokens, which drain as calls are served and refill over time

parts.what: the container itself, open at the top
three identical tokens stacked inside, each separately controllable
the fill the tokens sit in, so how full it is reads at a glance

objects.represents: The service behind the limiter that does the real work when a call is admitted

parts.what: the machine body, a stacked rack rather than a plain box
the slot an admitted call arrives in
a light that shows it working

objects.represents: One call from one user, travelling between the things on the page

parts.what: the packet itself, small and unmistakable while moving
a mark that can turn from neutral to refused

objects.represents: A fixed row of work slots, each either free or occupied by one call in progress
objects.subject: concurrency limits

parts.what: the frame that holds the row, making the number of slots countable at a glance
four identical slots in a row, each separately controllable
the mark that shows a slot is taken, so how full the pool is reads at a glance
the mouth work passes through on its way in

objects.represents: The line work stands in when every slot is taken, emptying from the front as slots free
objects.subject: concurrency limits

parts.what: the lane the waiting work stands in, open at both ends
three identical items queued along it, each separately controllable
a mark on the one at the front, the next to be admitted
